task.description:
Step 3 — Implement the fix for ISS-0717 / GH-816 per the validated design at src/design/wf03-gh816-vld04-patch-gate-fix.md.

Branch: feature/WF03-GH816-20260817 (already created and pushed in Step 00)

Implementation steps:
1. In src/api/routes/definitions.zig, function handlePatch: insert the runSemanticGate call block after store.update succeeds and defer freeDefinition(def) is registered, before the serializeDefinition / HTTP 200 return — matching the exact pattern in handlePut (see lines 412-444 in that function).
2. HTTP return contracts: gate .valid -> continue to 200; gate .invalid -> HTTP 422 with findings body; gate .timeout -> HTTP 422 with validation_timeout; gate errors -> propagate.
3. DO NOT modify main.zig, web/src/api/definitions.ts, or any file other than src/api/routes/definitions.zig (and the test file for TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH).
4. Add TC-VLD-04-AC1-PATCH to tests/integration/vld04_gate_test.zig per the design spec: create definition, PATCH with finding-producing body, assert HTTP 422, assert semantically_valid = false in DB.
5. Run zig build (exit 0 required).
6. Run zig build test-integration-vld04 (or equivalent) to confirm the new test passes.
7. Commit with message: fix(GH-816): wire runSemanticGate into handlePatch for VLD-04 AC1 enforcement
8. Push to feature/WF03-GH816-20260817.
